logp.method_description: The lipophilicity (log Po/w) was determined by the flask-shaking method and ICP-MS analysis. Equal volume 0.9%(w/v) NaCl aqueous (saturated with octanol) was added into a 2 ml saturated stock solution(obtained supernatant by centrifuge) of gold complex in n-octanol (Alfa Aesar, saturated with 0.9%(w/v) NaCl aqueous), and the mixture were shaken in the oscillator for 24 h. The mixture was separated toobtain the oil and water phases. The mixtures were then centrifuged at 5000×g for 5 min. The oil andwater phases were separated carefully and dried under vacuum. The dried samples were dissolved byHNO3 (Alfa Aesar, 65%, 300 μL) and diluted to a final volume of 5 mL with Milli-Q water containing 10ppb In. The Au(III) concentration (Co or Cw) was measured by ICP-MS using as the internal reference.The Po/w value corresponds to Co/Cw.
